items.issue: The video says a man without a self will cause even a good woman to become abusive or exploitative.
items.disposition: Do not use this as an explanation of abuse, betrayal or financial exploitation; responsibility remains with the actor.

items.issue: Named public cases, money, divorce and relationship conduct are summarized from edited clips without primary records or context.
items.disposition: Treat only as Mikey's commentary; verify primary records before repeating any factual or legal allegation.

items.issue: The attack on needing positive feedback could be misread as permission to proceed under intimate uncertainty.
items.disposition: Preserve the distinction between general approval-seeking and affirmative consent; uncertainty requires slowing down and checking.

items.issue: The upload repeatedly generalizes women, men and attraction from anecdotes and fictional examples.
items.disposition: Keep only bounded statements about motives and self-expression; do not generalize outcomes by gender.

items.issue: Family, school and social conditioning are presented as a near-universal cause of approval-seeking and later relationship outcomes.
items.disposition: Do not diagnose a user's upbringing or predict their relationships from this source.

items.issue: Names, quoted clip dialogue and several ideological terms are unstable in the automatic transcript.
items.disposition: Avoid exact quotation or factual attribution without original-audio and source-clip review.
